name: Mahfi Eğilmez
detail: Published comprehensive essay arguing that due to Turkey's high informality, taxing registered wealth penalizes compliant taxpayers and evokes 1942 Varlık Vergisi memories; recommends expenditure audits instead.

name: Ergün Atalay
detail: President of Türk-İş. Campaigns for tax justice ('az kazanandan az, çok kazanandan çok vergi') and income tax reform, but does not propose a net wealth tax.

name: Erkan Baş
detail: Chairman of TİP. In TBMM speeches advocates general progressive taxation ('zenginlerden daha fazla vergi alınmalıdır') without naming net wealth tax in his own spoken remarks; TİP party organization is included under party resolution.
